evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Multilingual language models often produce inconsistent answers to semantically equivalent questions across languages, motivating methods to improve cross-lingual consistency (CLC).

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across two benchmarks of culturally diverse question answering, we find no systematic degradation in controlled closed-form evaluation, whereas open-ended generation reveals occasional accuracy reductions, particularly for non-English responses.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Our work highlights the need to evaluate CLC enhancement for both cross-domain robustness and culturally appropriate variation, informing future work in post-training and benchmark development.
